data.one_liner: An easy-to-use and highly customizable expandable list widget for your Flutter application.
data.what_it_does: Provides an expandable list widget and list items for Flutter applications. Allows users to toggle items to show or hide their content.
use_when: You need an expandable accordion or toggle list widget in your UI.
You want customizable titles and content for collapsible list sections.
avoid_when: You need complex state management libraries rather than UI widgets.
You require a package that is widely tested in production environments.
strengths: Easy to use with a straightforward declarative API.
Customizable items and properties like inner padding and dividers.
weaknesses: The package is explicitly noted as not yet widely tested.
Limited feature scope beyond expandable lists.
